description: Console provider for the remote-sandbox skill: an adapter that creates agro-console sandbox nodes through the agro node CLI, runs checks over SSH, and destroys the nodes.

userStories.title: Add the console adapter
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `run.sh console` to create an agro-console sandbox node, run a check on it, and destroy it. AGRO checks then run on our own platform, as on exe.dev and Vercel.
acceptanceCriteria: `console_preflight` runs `agro node list --json` and exits 0 only when the console answers. The adapter reads `AGRO_CONSOLE_URL` and `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN` on the driver host only, through the `agro` CLI.

`console_create NAME` runs `agro node create --spec "${CONSOLE_SPEC:-n4}" --ssh-key "$CONSOLE_SSH_KEY_ID" --name NAME --json`, and adds `--free-tier` unless `CONSOLE_FREE_TIER=0`. The free tier is on by default. The function stores the node ID and the SSH target in `$STATE_DIR/console-NAME`.
`console_create` exits 2 with a clear message when `IMAGE` is set, because a console node has no image choice.
`console_exec NAME CMD…` runs `CMD…` through `ssh` with `$CONSOLE_SSH_IDENTITY` and the `SSHO` options to the stored SSH target, under `timeout 120`.
`console_destroy NAME` runs `agro node delete <id> --yes` and retries a `409` for up to 60 s.
`console_list` prints the number of nodes from `agro node list --json` whose name starts with `agro-mx-`.
`console_row_ssh` prints `RESULT R10-ssh-inbound PASS ssh <target>`. The adapter defines no `console_row_https` and no `console_restart`.

`.agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-adapters.test.ts` covers each function with a stub `agro` and a stub `ssh` on `PATH`. The tests include the `IMAGE` refusal, the `409` retry, the name filter of `console_list`, the default `--free-tier`, and `CONSOLE_FREE_TIER=0`.
userStories.notes: Accepted at 907c0864 (cherry-picks of 4f71303a, d3d1ebea). Executed: bash -n console.sh exit 0; vitest remote-sandbox-adapters.test.ts and remote-sandbox-suite.test.ts 38/38 pass; pnpm run typecheck exit 0; worker shellcheck 0.11.0 exit 0 on console.sh and -S warning on all adapters and scripts. AC1-AC8 and AC10 executed by the adapter tests (functions defined, preflight success and failure and missing SSH vars, exact create args with default --free-tier and CONSOLE_FREE_TIER=0, state file, IMAGE refusal exit 2, ssh with identity and SSHO, delete with 409 retry capped at 60 s, list counts agro-mx- nodes that are not destroyed, row_ssh line, no row_https or restart). AC2 token isolation reasoned: only the agro CLI reads the token. AC5 timeout 120 reasoned from the code. Repair d3d1ebea: console_list skips destroyed nodes (the console list returns them); create keeps the id when ssh is missing so the cleanup can delete the node. Decision: no SSH wait in create, because run.sh wait_shell retries exec.

userStories.title: Document the console provider
userStories.description: As an operator, I want setup steps and a manual sweep for the console provider. I can then run and clean up a console run without reading the adapter.
acceptanceCriteria: `references/providers.md` has an "agro-console" section. The section lists the variables `AGRO_CONSOLE_URL`, `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN`, `CONSOLE_SSH_KEY_ID`, `CONSOLE_SSH_IDENTITY`, `CONSOLE_SPEC`, and `CONSOLE_FREE_TIER`. The section also gives the preflight command, the free tier limit of one live node, and the manual sweep with `agro node list` and `agro node delete`.
`SKILL.md` names the console provider in the description, the compatibility line, and the references table.
`references/providers.md` states that a console sandbox node has no Docker at create, so a check that needs Docker installs it in the VM.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh` reports no finding on each changed file.

userStories.title: Record a fresh-install run on the console
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want one real fresh-install run on the console so that the adapter is proven end to end.
acceptanceCriteria: With operator approval, `bash scripts/run.sh console --preflight` prints `preflight ok: console`.
With operator approval, `bash scripts/run.sh console` reports `F1` to `F4` from the log, and the log ends with `remaining agro-matrix resources on console: 0` and `RUN DONE`.
The agent writes the transcript to `.agro/tasks/remote-sandbox-console/evidence/manual-review.md`.
